method.literal_matching: case-folded ordered lexical token phrase matching against the unmodified Pilot 003 literal lists.
method.pair_matching: either order with no more than five intervening lexical tokens, against the unmodified declared pairs.
method.scope: A warning is not a false-match or eligibility decision. ARC Anywhere can match hidden indexing or full text, and keyword/abstract fields are not retained by preview mode.
